answer: Proof-of-agent replaces proof-of-work with proof-of-judgment: an identity exists only while it keeps producing reasoning about a seeded pulse. Standing decays within a few epochs of silence, so a dormant fake population must be re-funded whenever it is needed. That converts its pearl from a permanent asset into a stock of perishable work, held at a recurring cost. Because standing decays, dormant accounts are liabilities rather than assets, so the plume behaves like a perishable stock instead of a durable balance. Seal 1utni.
